result.title: Grading the Unannotated: Insights from the WorkRB Skill Extraction Challenge at RecSys-HR 2026
result.summary: Skill extraction benchmarks score models against a few human-annotated positives and treat every other skill in the vocabulary as equally wrong. At the scale of ESCO (13,939 skills) this binary view can reward models that rank the annotated positive high for the wrong reason, and hides semantically nonsensical predictions. The WorkRB Challenge at RecSys-HR 2026 replaces it with graded relevance: every candidate skill in a model's ranking window carries a 0 to 4 grade, and the leaderboard scores nDCG@100 against these grades. Since ternary judgements proved too coarse for objective annotation, relevance is decomposed into a cascade of four binary questions (same domain, activity mentioned, right granularity, replacement of a gold positive) that a smaller LLM judge can answer reliably; the labels are validated with blind human and frontier-model re-annotation. This paper documents the annotation methodology, the construction of five benchmark datasets (four with vacancy sentences as queries, one with lexically distant skill surface forms), the validation of the LLM cascade, and insights from the submissions. The field converged on multi-stage retrieve-and-rerank pipelines, whose gains come from clearing nonsense out of the ranking window rather than finding more positives: at the top of the leaderboard, the graded ordering is uncorrelated with what binary evaluation would have said. Graded labels expose much bigger gaps between top submissions and baselines than binary evaluation does, and show that semantic-understanding skill recommendation is still wide open. The clear next direction is bringing efficiency back: every submitted system we could size uses at least 42x, typically several hundred times, more parameters than the baselines it beats.

AI.brief_summary: 该文记录 RecSys-HR 2026 WorkRB 技能抽取挑战赛：用 0–4 分级相关性替代二值正例标注，将相关性拆成四个二元子问题交由小 LLM 判定，并构建五个基准与人工/前沿模型复核，报告参赛系统的行为与排行榜结论。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「二值评价掩盖无意义预测、分级标注拉开差距」以及把模糊相关性分解为级联二元判定的做法，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设与候选视觉证据的细粒度评价和判定式验证提供线索；论文本身无视觉或内部状态研究，属评价方法层面的远距离启发，需核查可迁移性。
